name: Logo Orbit
description:
Hover the Ubuntu logo on your wallpaper to open a circle of your Desktop files and folders.

Click an item to open it, rest on a folder to peek inside, and drag files in and out of the circle. Items in the circle stay in ~/Desktop: they are only hidden from the desktop icons (Desktop Icons NG) by listing them in ~/Desktop/.hidden, and disabling the extension shows them again.

The logo lines up with the Snowy Ubuntu wallpaper; on other wallpapers it sits in the centre of the main screen.
